# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Removed the dead comammox `alk_budget` shadow update and its misleading future-proofing comment in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs`, so the code no longer implies an in-use post-comammox alkalinity remainder that nothing reads. The existing total alkalinity consumption accounting (`aob_alk_cost + comammox_alk_cost`) remains intact, and the requested focused validation was rerun successfully.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the nitrogen-cycle comammox budget logic around the reported `alk_budget` shadowing issue to confirm whether any downstream consumer actually read the remainder.
2. [Completed] Removed the dead post-comammox `alk_budget` update/comment from `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs`, keeping the real dissolved-oxygen debit and later total alkalinity consumption logic unchanged.
3. [Completed] Reran the requested focused validation suite for save/load behavior, TUI tests, and clippy with warnings denied.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` passed: 10 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p tank_tui` passed: 2 unit tests passed, 0 failed; main/doc tests also passed.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_tui -- -D warnings` passed with no warnings.

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
